claim: `akasha index refresh` repairs the whole index and then exits 2, because one page names a relation target whose slug is empty.

evidence: `page/view/pages/-personas.view.ts` states `nav: "nav/"`. The address parts to the page type `nav` and the slug ``, and no page carries that slug, so the entry refuses. The refresh reports `77326 pages, 1153214 entries, 1 refused` and closes with ``the index took less than the whole of it — /var/home/walton/repos/akasha/page/view/pages/-personas.view.ts: `nav` — no `nav` carries the slug ``.`` Everything else is written: the run that swept the flat id entries repaired `.index` in place and committed at `0ce36f30` before it refused. So the exit code says a refresh failed where a refresh wrote every file it meant to, and a caller reading the code rather than the report reads the refresh as stopped part way.
